name: @telicent-oss/eslint-plugin-ds
//private: private until we get an npmjs.org package created
description: ESLint rules enforcing the Telicent design system manifest: Tailwind may do layout, size and spacing, and nothing else.
//main: the esm entry: this package is esm only, see vite.config.ts

..//types: first: conditions resolve in order, and only dist/index.d.ts is emitted

scripts.//dist: committed, so a git-pinned consumer needs no build on install. There is deliberately no prepare script
scripts.verify-dist: rm -rf ./dist && vite build && git diff --exit-code -- dist

//peerDependencies: the rule's visitor API is identical in 8 and 9; consumers on flat config run 9
//dependencies: the emitted index.d.ts references eslint's Rule type, and eslint 8 ships no types of its own, so a consumer on 8 cannot resolve it unless this comes with the package
